method: Built-in image_gen; original generated raster assets, no external game artwork.

background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art chicken restaurant game empty kitchen backdrop, landscape 3:2. Original warm lively tiny Korean fried chicken kitchen. Strict straight orthographic top-down with a little front face visible like classic 2D RPG, NOT isometric. Clear flat unobstructed central tiled floor covering x10%-90%, y25%-85%; subtle small cream and mint tiles, no huge grid. Upper back wall has detailed hanging cooking utensils, steel vent hood, spice shelves, little clock, green and yellow trim. Left/right wall narrow details only. Bottom band a clean customer waiting floor. No machines or furniture anywhere on central floor, no counter, no characters, no text/UI/logos. Sharp cohesive hand-pixeled medium density, clean pixel clusters and restrained shadows, teal steel warm yellow red accents. This image will be a game background behind separately rendered machines at fixed grid coordinates; keep playable floor empty. No perspective convergence, no room diagonal edges, no blur.

equipment.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas on genuine transparent background. EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows of square cells, each isolated object centered with 15% padding, no objects crossing cells. Row1 left: stainless raw bone chicken ingredient bin visibly containing pink drumsticks; middle: matching steel boneless ingredient bin pink cubed chicken; right: single-basket deep fryer with one rectangular golden oil bath and ONE wire basket, dark green front panel, knob. Row2 left: stainless sauce mixing workbench with big round red sauce bowl and small bottles; middle: cardboard chicken box packing bench with one open box and stack of folded boxes; right: warm wood pickup sales counter with green trim and cash register. Consistent straight orthographic top-down RPG view with front faces visible, NOT isometric. Detailed handmade crisp pixel-art steel reflections, warm dark green/yellow/red accents, original cozy chicken shop. Each object square footprint and same scale. No text, no grid lines, no background scenery, no characters, no shadows extending beyond own cell. Six machines only.

characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for original cozy pixel-art chicken restaurant game. EXACT 4 columns by 5 rows uniform grid of twenty equal cells, full body centered, every figure same scale, generous padding, aligned feet. NO labels NO lines NO scenery, genuine transparent background. Crisp handmade RPG pixel art, orthographic straight overhead/front three-quarter view NOT isometric. Chibi readable face, detailed clothing, limited warm green/red/yellow palette. Rows 1-3 depict SAME young cook with brown hair, white chef hat, red shirt and dark green apron: row1 idle facing DOWN, UP(back view), LEFT, RIGHT; row2 walk stride A facing DOWN, UP, LEFT, RIGHT; row3 opposite stride B facing DOWN, UP, LEFT, RIGHT. Row4: novice employee front with simple green apron no hat; skilled employee front with red cap navy apron; veteran employee front white toque white doublebreasted coat gold scarf; customer front woman black bob yellow jacket. Row5: customer front man glasses blue jacket; customer front woman brown ponytail coral sweater; customer front older man gray hair green shirt; customer front young man dark cap purple hoodie. Distinct real silhouettes, no weapons, no extra limbs. Keep every figure entirely inside its own 1/4 width x1/5 height cell. Match sprite density across all people.

runtime: externalArt.ts alpha-trims atlas cells, normalizes sprite footprints and adds small job-driven overlays. Source PNG alpha is preserved.
audio: Original deterministic procedural WAV recordings rendered offline by scripts/make-kitchen-audio.mjs. No downloaded samples or CDN.
